# Support

Thanks for watching Succubus Live. Here is how to get help.

## Before you ask
- Read the [README](../README.md).
- Search the [existing issues](https://github.com/nao1215/succubus-live/issues); your question may already be answered.

## Where to ask
- Question: open a [Question issue](https://github.com/nao1215/succubus-live/issues/new?template=question.md).
- Bug: open a [Bug report](https://github.com/nao1215/succubus-live/issues/new?template=bug_report.md).
- Idea (a topic, a reaction, a feature): open a [Feature request](https://github.com/nao1215/succubus-live/issues/new?template=feature-request.md).

When reporting a problem, include the version (or "browser"), your OS or phone, your browser, and what happened. For a wrong line, the streamer and what she said help the most.

## Security
Do not report security issues in public issues. Follow the [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md).
